title: spec(view): narrow `FormView.type` to layout only (`simple | tabbed | wizard`) — retire `split`, `drawer`, `modal` with tombstones (ADR-0050 Accepted, #27032 letter A′)
body:
Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed). Ruling 6464210455 on #27032 (batch #421 item 3, letter A′, maintainer 「其他同意」 2026-10-28): ADR-0050 Accepted, the cutover lands now as a `(narrowing)` minor. Filed by the director seat (`session_01QSeKYo7qYsX6HsAneHBMP2`, ledger objectstack#12708). ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets the lane (`domain:spec` expected) and grade.

Ruling-ref: 6464210455

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** `FormView.type` 只剩布局三值 `simple | tabbed | wizard`；`split`、`drawer`、`modal` 发布时拒收，拒收信息带迁移处方（`split` → 列表的 `navigation.mode: 'split'` + `subforms`；`drawer` / `modal` → 调用方的打开方式）。`section.pane` 随 `split` 退役。
- **为什么改：** 一个字段混两维（布局 + 呈现 + 视图模式），「模态框里放 tabbed 表单」已经靠 #1890 实现，三个冗余值零业务使用（本树 showcase `task` 2 处、hotcrm `lead` 3 处，全是演示视图）。
- **风险与回滚：** BREAKING（narrowing）；本仓无 spec-major 窗口，按 AGENTS.md L1084–1090 走 minor + 迁移 + tombstone + ADR-0087 处置（先例 #24692 B′）。渲染器半边是子卡，先于本卡合并会让演示视图发布失败 ⇒ 子卡 `Blocked-by:` 本卡，两者同窗落地。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:4546–4551` 与 L4034（`pane`）、L4619–4627。
- **两分钟验证：** 一个 `type: 'modal'` 的 form view 在 `objectstack build` 被拒且信息点名迁移路径。
- **需要您做的：** 无（spec PR 不是受管面；若 PR 顺带改 `docs/adr/0050-*` 状态行则需您批）。

## Measured (on `origin/main` `e6e41998`, 2026-10-28)

- Enum: `view.zod.ts:4546–4551` lists six values, default `simple`.
- Live usage of the three values (non-test): `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/views/task.view.ts:421` (`split`), `:431` (`drawer`); hotcrm `src/sales/views/lead.view.ts:747` (`split`), `:796` (`drawer`), `:839` (`modal`) at hotcrm `6c52f22` (spec pin 18.2.0). No business metadata.
- Renderer still executes them: `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx` L41–42 imports, L516 / L553 branches; `ModalForm.tsx:167, 950` carry the #1890 layout forwarding (kept).

## Task

- [ ] `FormViewSchema.type` → `z.enum(['simple','tabbed','wizard'])`; `split` / `drawer` / `modal` refused with `retiredKey()`-style tombstones carrying the FROM → TO mapping above; `section.pane` retired with `split` (tombstone).
- [ ] The `spec-property-retirement` kit: ADR-0087 disposition in the changeset, liveness ledger, generated baselines / forms / docs, pin tests; stored-metadata survey of the three values (expected: the five demo views only).
- [ ] Re-spell `examples/app-showcase` `task.view.ts` L421 / L431 to layouts (`tabbed` / `simple`) and demo the open modes via the list's `navigation.mode`.
- [ ] ADR-0050 status line → "Accepted — cutover card #N (this card)": rides the #26553 closeout docs PR (Tier H), or its own XS PR; ⛔ not mixed into this spec PR.
- [ ] hotcrm `lead.view.ts` L747 / L796 / L839: owed to the hotcrm seat (unreachable from the filing session); named in the PR body as `Skills-docs: follow-up owed — hotcrm src/sales/views/lead.view.ts`.

`Clause-②: no (narrowing)` · `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` · `Skills-docs:` line owed in the PR body.

Child: the renderer half (`domain:ui`) is its own card, `Blocked-by:` this one. Dedupe: #27032 (ruled, closed), #24692 (closed, B′), #1890 (closed, the unlock), objectui#1763 (key drift, out of scope); no open card narrows `FormView.type`.
